summary: The 68.6 x 53.3 mm ATmega328P board every shield is drawn for. Its USB-B powers it and carries its serial port through an ATmega16U2; its 2.1 mm DC barrel jack, beside it on the same edge, powers it from a supply instead. This entry has the two sockets on that edge, laid out as a camera facing the edge sees them, and not yet its headers.
